Iska jawab hai 9/7, kyunki 6 marks se har poore ke 7 barabar gaps bante hain, toh har gap 1/7; 0 se 9 gap chalkar 9/7 aata hai, jo 1 ke aage hai. Aaj ki baat yeh thi ki har fraction ki number line par ek pakki jagah hoti hai: neeche wala number 0 se 1 ke barabar gaps ginta hai, aur upar wala batata hai 0 se kitne gap chalna hai. Jab upar wala number neeche wale se bada ho, toh fraction 1 ke aage aata hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge.
